divergence_justification: ICU MedicationAdministration does not serialize mimiciv_icu.inputevents.linkorderid in MedicationAdministration.identifier, MedicationAdministration.supportingInformation, or any other FHIR path, as confirmed by MIMIC_NOTES.md and mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:7-23,38-100. This explains all 9,573 keyed differing_null_only rows on the declared typed-NULL linkorderid; all 9,573 rows are identical on representable columns, with no other divergence. Exact medication coding, ICU Encounter identifier mapping, both effective variants, TIMESTAMP_NTZ conversion, Quantity casts, and permitted opaque equality joins were exhausted. Resource-id inversion is forbidden. linkorderid is ancillary and affects neither inclusion, key (stay_id,starttime), grouping, windows, nor clinical values. No divergent dependencies exist.

reopen_history.reason: This port was completed before the resource-key lint that validate-demo now enforces, and it does not emit patient_key, so it cannot be carried forward unchanged. Add patient_key -- taken verbatim and uncast from the Patient view, or from a reference to it -- and change nothing else about the logic. The warehouse was rebuilt on 2026-08-24 after two upstream data defects were fixed: FHIR resources are now generated under UTC, so wall-clock timestamps are no longer shifted an hour across the spring-forward boundary, and Patient.birthDate is now derived from the anchor year and age rather than from the first transfer, so expect previously accepted divergences to have shrunk or gone.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: ICU MedicationAdministration carries no inputevents.linkorderid FHIR element or identifier, explaining the declared typed-NULL ancillary column and 9,569 differing_null_only rows; exact medication, Encounter identifier, both effective variants, TIMESTAMP_NTZ, numeric casts, and opaque equality joins were tried. The remaining 4 underlying affected administrations (2 endtime conflicts plus 2 shifted starttime key pairs) are fully and exactly attributed with zero residual to mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:8-9,61-69, whose TIMESTAMPTZ DST-gap normalization is irreversible and affects 0.0418% of 9,573 rows. No resource-id inversion was used and no divergent dependencies exist.
